cp.str.title: One plan for every partner. <red>Your rate grows with you.</red>
cp.str.sub: Whether you run a trading channel, a community, a course or a network of partners, you earn on the same transparent plan.
cp.str.l1: TradeQuo earns from the spread — the difference between the bid and ask price.
cp.str.l2: As a partner, you receive up to 87% of the spread on every lot your referred clients trade.
cp.str.l3: You keep earning for as long as your clients stay active.

cp.perks.title: More than <red>commission</red>
cp.faq.title: Commission <red>questions</red>
cp.faq.sub: How the plan works, in plain words.
cp.faq.1.q: What do I earn as a TradeQuo partner?
cp.faq.1.a: A commission on every lot your referred clients trade, worth up to 87% of the spread. If you build a network, you also earn on the partners you bring in.
cp.faq.2.a: It depends on your tier and your clients’ volume: $5.00 per lot on Starter (0–50 clients), $7.50 on Gold (51–200) and $10.00 on Elite (200+). Use the calculator above for an estimate.
cp.faq.3.a: Every day. Commissions settle at 00:00 server time, and we cover processing and withdrawal fees.
cp.faq.4.q: How does the spread-based commission work?
cp.faq.4.a: TradeQuo earns from the spread on each trade. You receive a share of it — up to 87% — on every lot your referred clients trade, for as long as they stay active.
cp.faq.5.q: How do I move up a tier?
cp.faq.5.a: Grow the number of active clients in your network. Your rate per lot rises from $5.00 on Starter (0–50 clients) to $7.50 on Gold (51–200) and $10.00 on Elite (200+).
cp.faq.6.q: Is there a limit on what I can earn?
cp.faq.6.a: No. There’s no cap on the number of clients you refer or the volume they trade.
cp.faq.7.q: Where can I get more details?
cp.faq.7.a: Send a partner request and your dedicated partner manager will walk you through the plan. We review every application within 24 hours.
cp.end.title: Join the TradeQuo <red>Partner Program</red>
cp.end.sub: Up to 87% of spread, paid every day. Applications are reviewed within 24 hours.
